ASHCROFT TRUST · PORTLAND — DISBURSEMENTS, VALE PROPERTY (bundle, 1937–1998)

1937 — taxes, county of Bellweather. Authorised: E.O.
1938 — boarding of west wing; carpentry. Authorised: E.O.
1946 — roof, slate. Authorised: E.O.
1968 — rebinding, vellum, one volume (account "W"). Authorised: E.O.
1971 — lamp oil, turret; caretaker's wages. Authorised: E.O. / A.V.
1972–1998 — all items. Authorised: A.V.
Oct 1998 — caretaker; lamp oil; porch provisions. Authorised: T. Mercer, executor.

details.note: Thirty-four years of the same initials, E.O., in the same small upright hand. In 1971 a second hand joins it: A.V.
